mechanism: Testosterone may increase haloperidol levels through CYP3A4 inhibition and both drugs can potentiate CNS depression and extrapyramidal side effects; haloperidol may also increase prolactin and antagonize testosterone's androgenic effects.
action: Monitor for increased haloperidol adverse effects (extrapyramidal symptoms, sedation) and testosterone efficacy; consider dose adjustment or alternative antipsychotic if clinically significant interaction develops.
